      end

      @todo.title = req.body['title'] || ''

require 'json'

class TodosController < ApplicationController

  def create
    todo = Todo.new body: params[:todo]
    authorize_task(todo)
    if todo.save
      render :json, todos: Todo.all, status: 201
    else
      render json errors: todo.errors.full_messages, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def update{id}
    authorize_task(params[:todo])
    todo = Todo.find(id)
    if todo.update params[:todo]
      render :json, todos: Todo.all, status: 201
    else
      render json errors: todo.errors.full_messages, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def destroy{id}
    authorize_task(params[:todo])
    Todo.find(id).destroy
    head :no_content
  end

  def index
    authorize_task(params[:todo])
    todos = Todo.all
    render :json, todos: todos, status: 200
  end

  private

  def authorize_task(task)
    if task.completed
      raise InvalidTodoError, "Cannot create or update completed todos"
    end

    unless task.todos.any?
      raise ValidationTodoError, "Cannot update incomplete todos"
    end
  end

end

class Todo < ApplicationRecord

  end

  end
